name: Metal Container Corporation - Mira Loma CA Can Plant

fieldNotes.truckGate: South-side main driveway is a wide open entrance with a landscaped median (rock + agave) and no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point. Street View Feb 2025 from Inland-area road shows free-flowing access. North and west property lines are palisade-fenced perimeter with grassy buffers and no vehicle gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the south entrance in satellite or Street View. A small structure exists on the NE annex but it is part of the can-end processing building, not an entrance booth. Low-confidence negative — booth could be obscured by entrance landscaping, but no evidence of one.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two buildings on one fenced parcel: the main can-manufacturing building (west, large white roof) and a separate NE annex building with rooftop tanks/silos (likely can-end or coatings processing).
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Counted ~12-14 dock doors along the building's south face under a continuous blue canopy at zoom 20; estimate, some doors may be obscured by trailers/shadows.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large paved truck yard wraps the south and SW of the building with ample marked space for parked trailers; only ~4 trailers present in the captured imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail corridor runs NE-SW immediately east and along the west of the property, but it is a through-line/spur shared with neighboring warehouses; no track enters the MCC building.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The south entrance driveway is very wide with a divided median, providing ample paved width to add a dedicated express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in the dense Mira Loma/Jurupa Valley industrial fabric of the Inland Empire metro - surrounded by large distribution warehouses on all sides.
